comments.value:
Imo, it should be limited to one account only. Not multiple. Many people will simply verify for other people. I rather have it 'safe' and less chance of running into someone who has been verified by a friend of theirs while not being above the age of 18, which we all know will definitely happen on quite a big scale if people can verify more than once. 

The only solution I see for this which could be; Allow people to retract their verification status and then be able to put it on an other account.

Still hoping we can have a system where we can verify multiple accounts with the same hash, with the hard rule that any action taken against one account would be applied to any account with the same hash. Would literally solve the issue people have with potential for abuse.

It will never be allowed on multiple accounts. That opens up way to many potential issues. Users are already abusing AV. We dont need more. If your a content creator, why would you have AV on your stream account? makes no sense. Keep it on your casual account your usually on.

as for the drama argument or whatever, I dont belive thats worth potential security risks. Just use moderation tools.

Isn't there like some sort of checker that can determine if more than one account is active at a time? Or if the hash is in use at the same time? I feel that would be helpful.

As for multiple accounts; bot accounts do exist in order to get people into instances that are used as a default system to send invites and group announcements out. 

I feel it's necessary to have a multi id function because if you lose access to one account, be it a lost email or unable to get into either account, it's convenient to not lose out on the perks of the device. 

I just want a +1 account as there are sites that do allow for that sort of thing already. Could be a perk if you pay a premium vrc+ thing or even buy it in a shop and have that kept on record you bought an id verified additional account. That was it is linked to your account AND it keeps you on record should anything go wrong or is handed out.

@{62e87a9b53b97044b777191d|full_name} One of the points of using the hash outside of minimizing the amount of personal data stored was to have the ability to know if multiple accounts are using the same hash and potentially if there's enough demand allowing people to verify multiple profiles on a single hash, which I'm guessing comes with the caveat that if one account had action taken against it that said action would also be taken against any additional accounts connected to the hash.

@{5f2cf422a2990547bfbfbf22|full_name} I can't tell if this is agreeing with what I said or not. They would be using the same amount of personal data, just linking the additional accounts name to the record with my theory. Like a shared subscription service but rather a purchase that can be made multiple times to ensure the permanence. 

Like how steam only allows vrc+ to be purchased once per steam account. If you don't want an additional steam account for vrc +, you have to gift that to yourself or have it bought for you. If it was set up so could purchase an additional account with the perks it'd make plenty sales and the additional name could be stored on record. 

Much like how ingame purchases can still be made through multiple accounts and remembered but not vrc+ as a whole as that's considered externally.

@{62e87a9b53b97044b777191d|full_name} I was just giving information about how official channels have said they might use the hash system. I'm all for having a system where you can own multiple accounts under one profile if that's what you're proposing.

@{5f2cf422a2990547bfbfbf22|full_name} That is already happening, I got banned once for logging onto a customers Account, he got banned for doing stupid shit, and since my IP was logged on his account too I got banned as well until I was able to clear it up to Support.

I recently reached to VRChat support with this issue, as I have personal and content creation accounts, and was wondering the implications of trying to verify both, this is the reply I got, posting it here so people have more official information (hope it is ok to post this):

"Hi there,

 

Thanks for reaching out with your questions!

 

You can only complete Age Verification on one VRChat account per form of ID. If you’ve already verified an account using a particular ID, attempting to use the same ID on another account will result in an error. If you’d like to verify a different account instead, you’ll first need to remove verification from the currently verified account. Alternatively, if you have access to a second valid form of government-issued ID that is still yours, you can use that to verify a different account.

 

Please note that Age Verification does not publicly link or reveal any personal information across accounts, your identity will remain private and unassociated between accounts.

 

As for VRC+ subscriptions through Steam: a Steam account can only have one active VRChat account tied to its subscription at a time. The subscription doesn’t automatically link or associate any other accounts you may own, and it won’t cause any cross-account exposure.

Lilith

VRChat Team"

@{664e2f86068c989af06352e8|full_name} ok actually that is helpful for those of us that have different forms of ID. I'm definitely gonna give that a try with my alt. Kind of odd tho that you can verify with another ID and not just the one but oh well I guess

Seeming like this is dead in the water. If any creators want to be anonymous now I guess the solution is to choose whether they want their main or alt to be unable to access safe adult spaces or go through the trouble of getting another form of ID, which isn't feasible for a lot of people. Really disappointing.

@{664e2f86068c989af06352e8|full_name} How do you remove the verification from one account to put it onto another though? I don't see an option to revoke your ID verification. Did they clarify that at all?
@{684b02af1f4840cacf0008e0|full_name} Sorry, that email is all the info I have. I haven't tried to age verify yet myself

@{6449f7223e816f16885c76e2|full_name} I guess that the process Persona uses generates a unique token for the specific ID document, so different documents generate different tokens... Maybe, not sure. 

The way I understand it, you could use your government ID, driver's license and passport to verify 3 accounts, for example, depending on what your country considers a valid ID.

I would ask then if a specific type of ID is valid before trying, though.

@{664e2f86068c989af06352e8|full_name} I am an alter within a plural system. My host's first account was verified using my state ID (not a driver's license/learners). I was *not* able to verify this account using my driver's license. It seems that these two are the same to Persona, likely because both are technically a form of State ID despite serving two purposes.

I do not have a passport as I have not yet needed to travel abroad. This may change within the coming years, but hopefully I won't have to edit this reply to update it with the information of whether or not it worked... (To future readers: If no such edit exists, then I still couldn't try it)

I also need this, but for more than just two accounts. For alters and other reasons. I want to just be free to make alternates and verify them and feel safe doing so without judgement. I don't even care if VRChat kept all my personal information and kept a close watch on my accounts if it meant I can have my peace of mind to move between parts of myself without judgement. This one verification for one account Facebook'ish lockdown model forces me to deal with a serious question of making private parts of my life public that I really shouldn't have to. Being locked to one account, even just two accounts if I verified with a passport also, removes a critical part of what I enjoyed about VRChat - being able to escape.

This text is translated from Japanese to English using machine translation (DeepL).

The original Japanese text is attached after the English translation.

In Japan, some people create dedicated VRC accounts specifically for event casts.

This is often done to manage friends and contacts needed for events more easily, or to separate private interactions from public or event-related interactions.

Under the current system, where only one account can undergo age verification, users operating these accounts must choose to verify either their event account or their private account.

※ At the very least, repeatedly deactivating and reactivating verification for weekly events isn't practical, right?

If linking them as sub-accounts for the same person, wouldn't it be acceptable for one individual to verify multiple accounts?

At the very least, if the plan is to expand this functionality, restrictions, or other areas requiring such verification in the future, the specifications outlined in this Canny document seem highly worthy of consideration.

To be honest, I'm not familiar with the circumstances of communities in other countries, and unfortunately, I haven't encountered any communities where age verification is absolutely necessary and they're troubled by minors circumventing it.

That's precisely why the current anticipated specification—gradually making age verification mandatory and restricting it to one account per person—is “just making things inconvenient.”

Translated with DeepL.com (free version)

----------

機械翻訳(DeepL)を利用し、日本語から英語に翻訳しています。

英文の後に原文の日本語を添付します。

日本では、イベントのキャストをするために専用のVRCアカウントを作成している人々がいます。

これはイベント関連で必要となるフレンド等を管理しやすくするためである場合や、普段のプライベートな交流とパブリックやイベントでの交流を区分したい場合等に多くみられます。

現状の１アカウントのみ年齢認証出来る仕組みでは、こういったアカウントの運用を行っている人々はイベント用アカウントかプライベートアカウントのいずれかのみを認証することを選択する必要があります。

※少なくとも、週１回のイベントのために認証解除と再認証を繰り返すのは現実的ではありませんよね？

同一人物のサブアカウントとして紐付けるのであれば、複数アカウントを一人が認証出来ても問題ないのではないでしょうか？

少なくとも、今後この機能を必要とする機能や制限、その他のエリアを拡大していく方針なのであれば、本Cannyに記載された仕様は非常に検討の価値があるものになると感じます。

正直に申し上げて、他国のコミュニティの事情は存じませんし、年齢認証がどうしても必要で、それをかいくぐる未成年に悩まされているコミュニティにも残念ながら私は遭遇したことがありません。

だからこそ、年齢認証を今後だんだんと必須とし、それを一人１アカウントに制限する現在の想定される仕様は、「ただ不便になっただけ」なのです。

VRChat is a second life, and if so, I believe it is natural and reasonable to allow a third life as well.

I am not ignoring the problem of abuse through multiple accounts, but I think that should be addressed through separate measures.

I have no hesitation about paying for an nth life.

I can’t agree more with this

I’d say a hard cap of 3 accounts would be reasonable.

Let’s just hope VRChat doesn’t do what they to best here - and ignore it like many other things people ask for :>

details:
Per the updated FAQ for the announcement of Age Verification, I would like to suggest a hard limit of at least 1 or at most 2 alts who are eligible for the same age verification.

People may have alts for various reasons, some being that they may not want people who know their main VRC account name (especially if that name exists outside of VRC on other platforms) and may not want to engage with the more hardcore gated content (cough18+STUFFcough) for fear of other users maliciously looking them up and then harassing them on other platforms or even irl. I realize that may be an extreme example, but I can imagine I am not the only one who has their VRC name as their other socials and tries to keep it as professional as possible especially those that are creators.

And while you could just say...

"Well. Then just verify your alt account."

...and I could just do that, but what if in doing so I lock my main account off from my favorite worlds and or avatars should those world/avatar creators put their creations behind Age Verification gates.

I apologize in advance if this was hard to follow, I'm not the best at articulating my words, so I hope this made some sense...

I would just greatly appreciate being able to keep my main and an alt with the same amount of access and not feel like I have a baby gate in my way on one or the other despite being a fully grown adult. -_-
title: Please allow age verification on AT LEAST ONE other account.
